replacements.Grounding: qué significa que un modelo \: Grounding: what it means for a model to truly "see"
replacements.La diferencia entre responder desde la e: The difference between answering from visual evidence and answering from the statistical distribution learned during training.
replacements.Cuando un modelo responde correctamente,: When a model answers correctly, did it do so because it processed the image, or because the answer was statistically likely regardless of the image?
replacements.La imagen no determina la respuesta: The image does not determine the answer
replacements.respuesta más frecuente en el corpus: most frequent answer in the corpus
replacements.color real del objeto en la imagen: actual color of the object in the image
replacements.\"¿De qué color es el coche de la imagen: "What color is the car in the image?" — The actual car is red, but cars in the training corpus are mostly white or gray.
replacements.El fallo solo es detectable cuando el pr: The failure is detectable only when the statistical prior and the correct answer diverge. If the image shows the most likely case, the ungrounded model and the grounded model produce the same answer, and the benchmark cannot distinguish them.
replacements.El modelo acierta, pero pudo hacerlo sin: The model is correct, but it may have answered without looking at the image. The benchmark detects nothing.
replacements.El modelo falla. Solo este caso permite: The model fails. Only this case makes it possible to detect the absence of real grounding.
replacements.Un benchmark sin casos del segundo tipo: A benchmark without cases of the second type cannot distinguish a model with real visual understanding from one that guesses from probability. Results are valid only if the evaluation set systematically includes examples where the statistical prior fails.
replacements.Los benchmarks que corrigen este problem: Benchmarks that address this problem systematically include images where the correct answer violates the most frequent statistical expectations in the training corpus.
replacements.Un plátano azul, un coche verde brillant: A blue banana, a bright green car, a triangular building. If the model answers with the most common color or shape, the failure is unambiguous and cannot be attributed to chance.
replacements.Conteos que violan la norma estadística: Counts that violate the statistical norm
replacements.Si \"2 o 3\" domina en el corpus, el ben: If "2 or 3" dominates the corpus, the benchmark includes images with 7, 11, or 14 elements of the same type. An ungrounded model falls back to the usual statistical range even when the image shows something else.
replacements.La esfera debajo del cubo. La taza a la: The sphere below the cube. The cup to the left of the plate when the training prior is "to the right". Cases where the actual configuration reverses the statistical expectation.
replacements.Diseñado con contraejemplos donde el pri: Designed with counterexamples where the statistical prior systematically leads to error. Chen et al., 2024.
replacements.Evalúa consistencia y razonamiento espac: Evaluates consistency and spatial reasoning, not only final-answer accuracy. Li et al., 2023.
